canonicalRoutes.title: Rhythm Lab - Kareem Sasa

canonicalRoutes.title: Procedural Animations - Kareem Sasa

canonicalRoutes.title: Terminal - Kareem Sasa

canonicalRoutes.title: Erebus Case Study - Kareem Sasa

canonicalRoutes.title: Arachne Case Study - Kareem Sasa
canonicalRoutes.description: Autonomous research platform that searches, scrapes, versions, indexes, and synthesizes web content through a Go and Next.js pipeline.

canonicalRoutes.title: Where the Specification Lived Case Study - Kareem Sasa
canonicalRoutes.description: Two agents built the same Traffic Simulator in the same repository, one from a 38-word prompt and one from a 615-word specification. A blinded review of both artifacts shows what each prompt bought, and why prompt length and specification load are different variables.

canonicalRoutes.title: Mechanical Time - Kareem Sasa
canonicalRoutes.description: A mechanical watch movement assembles itself: components emerge, energy flows through the gear train, and the escapement releases time one tick at a time.

canonicalRoutes.title: DESCENT - Kareem Sasa
canonicalRoutes.description: A descent from the ocean surface to 2,437 metres, through the sunlight, twilight, and midnight zones, past fish and glowing jellyfish.

canonicalRoutes.title: Observing - Kareem Sasa
canonicalRoutes.description: On a rainy rooftop, an engineer and a small holographic dog look out over a cyberpunk skyline as a face built from glyphs emerges above the city.

canonicalRoutes.title: One Quiet Day - Kareem Sasa
canonicalRoutes.description: A meadow in the Blue Ridge foothills through one autumn day, compressed into a minute, with optional synthesized sound.

canonicalRoutes.title: What Should Still Be Hard - Kareem Sasa
canonicalRoutes.description: When machines can satisfy almost any present want, the harder question is which difficulties we keep on purpose, and who is in a position to keep them.

canonicalRoutes.title: Presence Is Not a Control - Kareem Sasa
canonicalRoutes.description: “Human in the loop” names an architecture, not a control. Oversight is a safeguard only while its conditions are maintained and its detection is tested.

canonicalRoutes.title: The Machine Should Explain Itself - Kareem Sasa
canonicalRoutes.description: A three-layer model of what AI agents know, and why operational intent belongs in versioned artifacts rather than in agent memory.

canonicalRoutes.title: The Work the Agent Stopped Doing - Kareem Sasa
canonicalRoutes.description: How durable records of authority, intent, disposition, and provenance shift agent work from reconstructing decisions toward judgment.

canonicalRoutes.title: What Should the Agent Have to Figure Out? - Kareem Sasa
canonicalRoutes.description: Which reasoning belongs in durable structure and which must stay live: a test of standing, reuse, and revisit for the records agents and operators read.

canonicalRoutes.title: The Centaur Era: Half Human, Half Machine - Kareem Sasa
canonicalRoutes.description: As delegation matures, the human role moves from operator to governor. A better machine does not automatically inherit the authority to decide.

canonicalRoutes.title: What the Second Agent Is For - Kareem Sasa
canonicalRoutes.description: “Multi-agent” now names incompatible working arrangements. What matters is how agents are related, not how many of them are running.

canonicalRoutes.title: Normal Is Not Inevitable - Kareem Sasa
canonicalRoutes.description: How markets built on real wants can reshape those wants, traced through makeup, razors, gambling, pharmaceuticals, and subscriptions.

canonicalRoutes.title: When Programming Became the Smaller Part - Kareem Sasa
canonicalRoutes.description: AI lowered the barrier to producing code in my work without lowering the standard for understanding the system. The judgment is still mine.

canonicalRoutes.title: The System Gets a Brake One Way or Another - Kareem Sasa
canonicalRoutes.description: Why competitive systems can keep accelerating after everyone sees the danger—and how coordination determines whether correction is chosen or imposed.

canonicalRoutes.title: Bottlenecks Don't Disappear. They Move. - Kareem Sasa
canonicalRoutes.description: Improving a constrained system relocates its bottleneck rather than removing it — and generative AI moved the constraint from production to judgment.

projects.title: Erebus
projects.summary: Event-driven coordination layer for Linux that captures system context, tracks inferred state, and turns reactive troubleshooting into auditable operational understanding.
features: Real-time system emitters (GPU, network, window focus, screen lock)
Full-text search over system event history
Append-only audit log with replay determinism
projects.publicEvidence: No public repository is listed. Treat public site copy as a sanitized summary.

projects.title: Aether
projects.summary: Linux audio-analysis daemon that publishes live frequency-band state through a sequence-versioned shared-memory region for independent local consumers.
highlights: Seqlock-versioned shared memory; readers never block the writer
Latest-value snapshot, not a message stream
features: 7-band FFT analysis at a nominal ~23 chunks/s (48 kHz, 2,048-sample chunks)
Seqlock readers reject uninitialized, in-progress, already-seen and changed-mid-read frames (8 CI-passed tests)
